summary: No mathematical errors or gaps were found. The zero-mass, n=1, singleton-support, and zero-volume boundary-fiber cases are covered. The primitive unimodular chart preserves the complete lattice and fiber measures. The rank-one slice satisfies every hypothesis of the accepted one-dimensional actual-body theorem; the rank-zero slice uses the accepted centroid bound. The same-point slice transfer and maximum-slice mass estimate yield exactly c_0 2^{-n} W for every containing closed ambient halfspace, with unchanged constants and continuous dimension.
